text:
maria: quick impl question from the lazy-reserve spike: can we ship this as ALLOC_LAZY flag wrapper to avoid SDK/API churn?

alex: yes, wrapper seems safest. allocator returns same handle; runtime sets page meta flag reserved_hint and ledger entry.

tomas: important to split quotas: light_reserve_budget vs resident_quota so evictor/admission aren't fooled.

jin: NUMA/offload detail: commit must honor NUMA prefs; async commit + fallback recommended. also rate-limit concurrent commits per-host.

lisa: perf from microbench: ~20% lower virtual frag for short lifetimes, but 99.9p commit tail ~8-10ms if blocking. hedging needed.

sre-jen: ops requirements: TTL default 200ms for reserved hints; GC on process exit; alert if reserved_never_committed_ratio > 0.1 over 1h.

raj: product: expose knobs max_light_reserve_bytes, reserved_timeout_ms, commit_hedge_mode. surface reserved_count and avg/99.9p commit latency.

maria: rollout plan: 1) ALLOC_LAZY wrapper, 2) ledger+TTL+GC, 3) async commit+hedge, 4) canary on dedicated behind feature flag. volunteers?

tomas: i'll take wrapper PR. alex: async commit. jin: NUMA tests.

maria: cool — i'll write the follow-up RFC and canary checklist. thanks all :thumbsup:
